title: 第4356章 鏖战半步神王第4355章 可谓是相当熟悉了
content_zh:
嗡嗡嗡……
源源不断有剑道道意释放出来，只是，还没到赵烈川和詹泽面前，便被两人身上释放的威压直接碾压。
“小子，你一个荒尘浊域土着，得罪万钧圣庭，你无论如何都是必死无疑。”赵烈川手中的大刀没有停，仍旧朝着秦浩斩下。
与此同时，他沉声开口，“将你手中的宝物交出来，我等还可以留你一具全尸，否则圣子前来可就不是对你出手那么简单……”
“以圣子的脾气，摧毁这座浊宇宙都未必没有可能，那个时候，你的族人，你的亲朋好友，全部都会因你而死。”
赵烈川声音不大，可却威胁意味极大，只不过他说这些话的时候，手中的大刀却是丝毫没有停。
显然赵烈川并没有真的只是威胁，而是真真切切的打算斩杀秦浩。
“何必跟他废话，杀了他，宝物也是我们的。”詹泽更是凶狠，威胁的话都懒得再说。
赵烈川眉毛一扬，不再废话，他之所以说这些话，其实更大原因乃是想要对方主动交出来，毕竟……
不怕一万就怕万一，万一此等宝物的消息泄露，单凭他们也很难保住这等宝物。
“轻松摧毁我的剑道道意？”秦浩并没有将赵烈川和詹泽的话当回事，甚至压根就没有去听两人的话。
将宝物交出去，然后送死？
别说秦浩，任何一个人都不可能这么做。
唯一让秦浩情绪有所波澜的，乃是赵烈川那番……雷钧曜一怒之下，会摧毁荒尘浊域。
秦浩的亲人，亲朋好友全部都要死。
不过现在的秦浩也顾不得那么多，何况就算真的交出宝物，但凡对方知晓这是玄尊级神兵……
只怕荒尘浊域的下场也差不多。
必然会杀人灭口，防止更多人知晓玄尊级神兵，开玩笑，镜湖玄天鉴虽说乃是玄尊级神兵，比红月洞府的天尊级神兵低一个等级。
但是……
但凡是尊级神兵，都是会引来无数人觊觎的，尤其是尊者，更是绝对不会错过。

“赵烈川实力最强，想要对付他，必须动用赤月归元斩，以我现在的修为和神力，足够施展五次赤月归元斩，既然如此……”
秦浩念头急速闪动，“那便先动用赤月归元斩和赵烈川一战，至于詹泽……便用九渊剑潮先行牵制，只要能重创，乃至斩杀赵烈川，剩下的詹泽就容易很多。”
如此战斗策略，秦浩之前就已经想到，这也是他的最强战力，赤月归元斩和九渊剑潮。
当然……
这是仅仅对战赵烈川和詹泽的情况，倘若加上一个左闵……情况可就完全不同。
哪怕秦浩全力以赴，都会疲于应付。
说来话长，实际上无论是赵烈川、詹泽，还是秦浩的思绪，都只是刹那之间的事情……
此刻，赵烈川和詹泽各自手中的大刀，已然来到秦浩面前，詹泽眼中更是露出兴奋之色。
仿佛已经看到自己一刀之下，秦浩当场身死陨落的场景，然后自己和赵烈川瓜分宝物。
一想到这里，詹泽就更加兴奋，尤其当看到面前秦浩，竟是若有所思，好似被自己两人的刀芒给吓住，竟是一下子都没有任何反应。
詹泽不由脸上更是露出一抹不屑和嘲讽之色。
“一个荒尘浊域的土着，不知道从哪里得到了天大机缘，就以为自己能媲美我等半步神王，可笑！”
詹泽心中讥讽，“或许你过去有所运气，可惜，从今天往后，你的运气便也到此为止。”
詹泽心中思索着，面孔则因为兴奋而变得有些扭曲，可是他那一抹兴奋还没持续多久，突然便猛地一僵，脸上露出一抹诧异之色。
content_en:
Buzz buzz...
A steady stream of swordsmanship was released, but before they could reach Zhao Liechuan and Zhan Ze, they were directly crushed by the coercion released by them.
"Boy, you are a native of the Wasteland and the Turbid Realm. If you offend the Wanjun Holy Court, you will definitely die no matter what." The sword in Zhao Liechuan's hand did not stop and continued to slash at Qin Hao.
At the same time, he said in a deep voice, "Hand over the treasures in your hands, and we can keep your whole body. Otherwise, it will not be as simple as the Holy Son attacking you when he comes..."
"With the temper of the Holy Son, it may not be impossible to destroy this turbid universe. At that time, all your people, your relatives and friends will die because of you."
Zhao Liechuan's voice was not loud, but it was very threatening. However, when he said these words, the sword in his hand did not stop at all.
Obviously Zhao Liechuan was not really just a threat, but really intended to kill Qin Hao.
"Why talk nonsense to him? Kill him. The treasure is also ours." Zhan Ze was even more fierce and didn't bother to say any more threats.
Zhao Liechuan raised his eyebrows and stopped talking nonsense. The bigger reason why he said these words was that he wanted the other party to hand it over on his own initiative. After all...
Don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of the eventuality. If the news of such treasures leaks, it will be difficult for them to save such treasures alone.
"Easily destroy my sword spirit?" Qin Hao did not take Zhao Liechuan and Zhan Ze's words seriously, and did not even listen to them at all.
Hand over the treasure and then die?
Let alone Qin Hao, it is impossible for anyone to do this.
The only thing that made Qin Hao's mood fluctuate was what Zhao Liechuan said... Lei Junyao would destroy the wasteland in his anger.
Qin Hao's relatives, relatives and friends will all die.
But now Qin Hao can't care so much, not to mention that even if the treasure is really handed over, as long as the other party knows that it is a Xuanzun-level magic weapon...
I'm afraid the fate of the Wasteland and Turbid Realm will be similar.
It will inevitably kill people and silence them to prevent more people from knowing about the Xuanzun-level magic weapon. Just kidding, although Jinghu Xuantianjian is a Xuanzun-level magic weapon, it is one level lower than the Tianzun-level magic weapon in Hongyue Cave.
But...
Any Venerable Divine Weapon will be coveted by countless people, especially the Venerable, who will never miss it.
"Zhao Liechuan is the strongest. If you want to deal with him, you must use the Red Moon Returning Slash. With my current cultivation and divine power, I can perform the Red Moon Returning Slash five times. In this case..."
Qin Hao's thoughts flashed rapidly, "Then first use the Red Moon Guiyuan Slash to fight Zhao Liechuan. As for Zhan Ze... use the Jiuyuan Sword Tide to contain him first. As long as he can severely damage or even kill Zhao Liechuan, the remaining Zhan Ze will be much easier."
With such a battle strategy, Qin Hao had already thought that this was also his strongest combat power, the Red Moon Guiyuan Slash and the Jiuyuan Sword Tide.
Of course...
This was only against Zhao Liechuan and Zhan Ze. If Zuo Min was added... the situation would be completely different.
Even if Qin Hao goes all out, he will be exhausted.
It’s a long story. In fact, the thoughts of Zhao Liechuan, Zhan Ze, and Qin Hao all happened in a split second...
At this moment, the broadswords in Zhao Liechuan and Zhan Ze's hands were already in front of Qin Hao, and Zhan Ze's eyes were even more excited.
It was as if he had seen the scene where Qin Hao died on the spot under his own sword, and then he and Zhao Liechuan divided the treasure.
When he thought of this, Zhan Ze became even more excited, especially when he saw Qin Hao in front of him, who was thoughtful, as if he was frightened by the light of his two swords, and he didn't react at all.
Zhan Ze couldn't help but show a look of disdain and ridicule on his face.
"A native of the wasteland, who got a great opportunity from nowhere, thinks he can compete with half-step god kings like us, it's ridiculous!"
Zhan Ze sarcastically said in his heart, "Maybe you were lucky in the past, but unfortunately, from today on, your luck will also be gone."So far. "
Zhan Ze was thinking in his heart, his face became a little distorted due to excitement, but his excitement didn't last long, and he suddenly froze, with a look of surprise on his face.
